_doc: CFTC's published Commitments of Traders RELEASE SCHEDULE for 2026, copied verbatim (release dates only; '*' = 'Delayed release date due to a federal holiday'). The test-only ORACLE for cot_service.expected_latest_report_date: the code derives every date by rule and hard-codes none of these. CFTC's page shows only the current year; no earlier full-year schedule is published there.
page_rule_text: The release usually includes data from the previous Tuesday.
Federal holidays may delay release by one or two days.
*Delayed release date due to a federal holiday.
